item.title: Trump says the Iran war "will continue for as long as necessary"
item.description: President Trump insists the U.S. is "achieving a very big victory" as the Iran war nears the six-month mark, and he has "no specific timetable" to resume peace talks.

item.title: Final witness testifies in Lindsay Clancy murder trial
item.description: The final witness testified Wednesday in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial for the killings of her three young children. CBS News legal contributor Jessica Levinson has more.

item.title: Tim Curry, star of "The Rocky Horror Picture Show," dies at 80
item.description: Tim Curry was known for his iconic performances in cult classics like "The Rocky Horror Picture Show" and the original screen adaptation of Stephen King's "It."

item.title: Trump calls Canada "one of the worst countries in the world to deal with"
item.description: President Trump said Wednesday that Canada is "one of the worst countries in the world to deal with" after trade talks with the United States' neighbors to the north collapsed. CBS News' Nancy Cordes reports.

item.title: When is the best time to buy pet insurance? Here's what pet owners should know now.
item.description: The timing can make a big difference in what your pet insurance covers and how much you pay for it.

item.title: Philadelphia's Chucky-style masked man arrested in Las Vegas

item.description: President Trump is lashing out at Canada after trade talks fell apart. The U.S. is imposing heavy tariffs, and Canada is promising to reciprocate. CBS News' Natalie Brand reports.

item.title: Ross Fire explodes to over 80,000 acres, forces evacuations in North Texas
item.description: The Ross wildfire has burned more than 80,000 acres across Palo Pinto and Jack counties, forcing evacuations, closing roads and disrupting schools.

item.description: Iran and Oman say they are edging closer to a temporary deal to jointly manage the Strait of Hormuz. CBS News national security analyst Aaron MacLean weighs in.

item.title: Meta settles social media addiction suit for up to $17.1 billion

item.description: The U.S. asked Ukraine to suspend its attacks against Russia as CIA Director John Ratcliffe traveled to Moscow. CBS News' Olivia Gazis reports on what we know and explains why the trip's visibility was unusual.

item.title: Meta to pay $17 billion settlement in social media addiction trial
item.description: Tech giant Meta will shell out up to $17 billion in a settlement following a massive multi-state legal suit on social media addiction. CBS News' Kelly O'Grady explains more.

item.title: Ring camera founder says company will "lock" video as Flock faces surveillance backlash
item.description: Conversations around privacy are growing as the surveillance technology company Flock faces allegations of police misuse and concerns that its roadside cameras are overly invasive. Ring inventor and founder Jamie Siminoff says his company is working to enhance customers' privacy.

item.title: How much interest can a $50,000 money market account earn over the next year?

item.title: Slain girl hailed as hero after 8 relatives killed in Montana home
item.description: The victims represented four generations of the blended family, ranging from a great-grandmother in her 90s who used a wheelchair to a 7-year-old girl, a neighbor said.

item.title: Sen. Darline Graham projected to win runoff in South Carolina GOP Senate primary
item.description: Sen. Darline Graham won the GOP Senate runoff in South Carolina on Tuesday night, CBS News projects, defeating Rep. Ralph Norman in the special primary to replace Graham's late brother, Sen. Lindsey Graham, on the ballot.

item.title: The Girl Who Knew Too Much
item.description: A teenage girl is discovered in her car, brutally murdered. Was she running for her life? Erin Moriarty reports. Case update: In December 2024, Leon Lamb, Mischelle Lawless' former boyfriend, was arrested and charged with her murder. He has pleaded not guilty and is scheduled to go on trial in February 2027.
